div.head: ECf 26
div.ab: De illis qui pacem regis habent, uel manu uel breui regis fiat, quin summum necesse est eis, ut eam seruent contra omnes legales.

div.ab: Concerning those who have the king's peace, whether it be done by the king's hand or by writ, indeed [?] it is most necessary for them that they keep it towards all law-worthy men.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl Königsfrieden 9—10; Handfrieden 9; Weihnacht, Ostern, Pfingsten. In Z. 1 bed. pax Sonderschutz durch den König, in Z. 3 ea aber Staatsbürgerpflicht der Landfriedenswahrung.
Cf. Gl Königsfrieden 9—10; Handfrieden 9; Weihnacht, Ostern, Pfingsten. In l. 1 pax means special protection by the king, but in l. 3 ea means the citizen's duty of keeping the public peace.
